description.en: Semaphore UI REST API credentials (endpoint + API token) for triggering Ansible playbooks
description.cs: Přihlašovací údaje k REST API Semaphore UI (endpoint + API token) pro spouštění Ansible playbooků

fields.name: Semaphore Endpoint URI
fields.description: Semaphore UI base URL (without /api suffix), e.g. https://semaphore.proxy.spojenet.cz

fields.name: Semaphore API Token
fields.description: Semaphore API token (Bearer), created in Semaphore UI under user API keys
